summary.text: Rusty Nelson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 21A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Krist Wollum.
A longtime science teacher with a Ph.D. in biochemistry, he has served as an EMT in his community for more than 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Rusty Nelson graduated from Red River High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Concordia College, Moorhead, in 1976, and received a Ph.D. from the University of North Dakota in 1986.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he conducted research for 13 years, including three years in Scotland, and then taught secondary science for 29 years and Spanish for four years.
He said he is a church trustee, president of the local Senior Center, a volunteer at a local nursing home, and has been an EMT in the community for over 20 years.
Nelson listed defending rural health care from Medicaid cuts, supporting volunteer fire and ambulance services, and stable markets and supply chains for agriculture as his key messages.
He named health care, education and the rural economy as his primary policy concerns.
